question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.list[].subagents.workspace` for same-agent default child workspace isolation, or keep explicit child agent profiles plus `requireAgentId` as the supported security boundary?
rationale: The request is not a broken existing contract; it adds public config and changes workspace-file access for default child subagents, so automation should not decide the security/product boundary.

options.title: Keep Explicit Profiles
options.body: Preserve the current model where safe isolation uses `requireAgentId` and configured child agent profiles with their own workspaces.

options.title: Add Narrow Opt-In Config
options.body: Implement `subagents.workspace` only for omitted-agentId same-agent children, with strict schema/docs/security tests and no effect on explicit target-agent spawns.

options.title: Defer To Broader Spawn Design
options.body: Hold this until workspace, cwd, sandbox, and skill workdir isolation are designed together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87253.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Profiles
recommendation.body: Preserve the current model where safe isolation uses `requireAgentId` and configured child agent profiles with their own workspaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest history is the spawned workspace override security-boundary work, making this the best available routing candidate for the policy decision.
